items.quote: To confirm the predicted thermal behaviors of the RE3Si2C2 phases in our calculations, the Pr3Si2C2 phase is taken as a typical case. Praseodymium (Pr) powders (99.5%, 75 μm; Sinopharm Chemical Reagent Co., Ltd.) and β-SiC powders (99.5%, 0.5 μm; Eno Material) were used as starting materials. The molar ratio of Pr to SiC powders was 3:2.

items.quote: The sintering was carried out by the spark plasma sintering (SPS; HP D25/1; FCT Systeme GmbH) at temperature of 1000°C in a flowing argon atmosphere. During the sintering process, the powders heated from 450°C with a heating rate of 100°C/min. The dwelling time was 10 minutes at the target temperature, during which, a constant uniaxial pressure of 50.9 MPa was applied.
